e: During 19th century, it was considered that the space that light waves traveled through was filled with an invisible hypothetical material called ether. vacuum is not ether, and plasma is not ether either. Traveled through was filled with an invisible hypothetical material called _____. ether.

q: Einstein special theory of relativity is based on two postulates, and the first postulate states that the laws of physics are the same in all _____ frames of reference.

q: The second postulate of special relativity states that the speed of light in vacuum is the same in all inertial frames of reference and is not affected by the speed of its _____.

q: An inertial frame is a frame of reference that has no acceleration, meaning all inertial frames are in a state of constant, _____ motion with respect to one another.

Put circular or random in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. A state of constant, _____ motion with respect to one another. rectilinear.

q: The consequences of Einstein special theory of relativity include relativity of simultaneity, relativistic effects on time interval, length, mass, momentum and _____.
e: The consequences of Einstein special theory of relativity include relativity of simultaneity, relativistic effects on time interval, length, mass, momentum and energy. charge is not energy, and temperature is not energy either. Rest energy is m0 c^2; moving mass grows as v approaches c.

q: Relativity of simultaneity states that two events that are simultaneous in one frame of reference may not be simultaneous in another frame moving _____ to the first frame.
e: Relativity of simultaneity states that two events that are simultaneous in one frame of reference may not be simultaneous in another frame moving relative to the first frame. parallel and perpendicular belong to other processes, not this relative case. Be simultaneous in another frame moving _____ to the first frame. relative.
